sentences.text:
This is first application filed by applicant under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.77/2023, registered at Police Station-Doraha, District Sehore (MP)
for the offence punishable under Section 363, 366, 376 of IPC and under Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that prosecutrix is aged about 17 years and mature girl.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.

Considering aforesaid circumstances of the case also taking note of age of prosecutrix and statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court.

7. In addition to aforesaid condition, the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
